items.title: Capital One Financial (COF) Completes €750 Million Twin Euro Bond Offerings
items.summary: Capital One Financial (NYSE:COF) has completed two euro-denominated bond offerings, each with a principal amount of €750 million. The new fixed to floating rate notes are scheduled to mature in 2032 and 2037, and extend the group's euro funding profile. Both Eurobond tranches add to Capital One Financial's presence in European fixed income markets and broaden its investor base.
